title: ATLAS common definitions
description: Building blocks shared by the message schemas in contracts/. Not a message on its own.

schema_version.description: Version of the message schema. Increased when a field is added, removed or changed (see contracts/README.md).

uuid.description: UUID in lower-case canonical form, for example 3f2b8c1e-6a4d-4f0e-9b7a-1c2d3e4f5a6b.

utc_timestamp.description: UTC time in ISO 8601 with the 'Z' suffix and up to microseconds, for example 2026-11-26T10:15:30.120Z. Local times and offsets are not allowed.

camera_id.description: Camera id from the camera configuration file of the vision service (S4PT-50), for example izum-001 or ibb-003.

event_type.description: Kind of event: an emergency vehicle with active beacons (FR-08), a stalled vehicle (FR-11) or an accident (FR-12).

lanes.description: Lane numbers as configured in the lane polygons of the camera (FR-11, FR-12, FR-20).
